description: LC3's resume on a running loop (S55 T5): a resume needs a parked loop, and the refusal says stop-first — one code, data.kind 'running', the remedy in the what. A resume that silently succeeded on a running loop would be a second runner on one loop; one that errored without the remedy would leave the person guessing.
